import polars as pl

# Create sample DataFrame
df = pl.DataFrame({
    "a": [5, 3, 7, 2],
    "b": [3, 2, 5, 1]
})

# Define row-by-row callback
def classify_row(row):
    a = row["a"]
    b = row["b"]
    return "hi" if a + b > 10 else "lo"

# Apply callback to each row
result = df.with_columns(
    pl.struct(pl.col("a"), pl.col("b")).map_elements(classify_row, return_dtype=pl.Utf8).alias("result")
)

print(result)

import polars as pl

df = pl.DataFrame({
    "a": [5, 3, 7, 2],
    "b": [3, 2, 5, 1]
})

def classify_row(row):
    a = row["a"]

    return "hi" if a + b > 10 else "lo"

# Apply callback to each row
result = df.with_columns(
    pl.struct(pl.col("a"), pl.col("b")).map_elements(classify_row, return_dtype=pl.Utf8).alias("result")
